hint.select: Select: click a run to edit its dots; drag handles to move, ghost dots to insert, Delete to remove.
hint.draw: Draw: click to place dots — or aim and type a length (4 = 4 m, {ex_mm} = {u}, 250cm) and Enter places the next dot exactly; Enter or double-click finishes the run, Esc cancels.
hint.gate: Gate: click a position on a run to place a gate.
hint.base: Base: click a section to choose the base surface for the whole section.
hint.ground: Ground: click a position on a run to set the ground elevation there.
hint.pin: Pin: click a position on a run to pin a post there.
editor.length_tooltip: Click to type an exact length; the run's end dot moves along the last segment (Enter applies, Esc cancels).
editor.invalid_length: length must be greater than {min_mm} {u} (the run up to its last segment)
confirm.delete_run: Delete this run? Its events are removed with it.
confirm.clear_topology: Clear all topology for this project?
inspect.title: Inspector
inspect.empty: Click a generated post, span, or gate.
inspect.correction_placeholder: what should be different, and why?
inspect.correction_recorded: Correction recorded. Use the Review tab to propose knowledge from corrections.
popover.pin_hint: Pin a post at this station (recorded as an override).
inspect.no_events: no events on this run — use the canvas tools to add some
warning.orphaned_override: Override {override_id} ({directive}) no longer matches the topology and was not applied.
warning.unknown_product: Gate kit '{sku}' is not in the catalog; BOM will price it at zero.
warning.knowledge_conflict: Conflicting knowledge for {slot}: {contenders} — the highest-priority version wins.
warning.node_surface_disagreement: Runs meeting at node {node_id} disagree on base surface ({surfaces}); using {chosen}.
critique.narrow_span: Span {span_id} is only {width_mm} {u} wide — check buildability.
profile.title: Side view
annotations.placeholder: e.g. keep the top aligned with the neighbour (approx. 1750)
knowledge.actions_json_discard: This JSON is not valid, so it cannot become rule rows. Go back to the rule builder and discard these edits?
api.request_failed: The action failed ({status}) — nothing was saved. Technical details are in the browser console.
knowledge.builder.conditions_hint: Rule conditions (when the rule applies) can currently be edited only in Advanced (JSON).
review.no_new: no new candidates from current corrections
bom.title: Purchase BOM
bom.inventory_not_used: No inventory item was used for this SKU — every bar is new stock.
bom.projected_remnants_hint: A projection for this quote — offcuts are not added to your inventory automatically.
bom.catalog_changed: The catalog has changed since this run was generated — press ⚙ Generate strategy to reprice against it.
inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.json_discard: This JSON is not valid, so it cannot become an inventory table. Go back to the table and discard these edits?
profile.empty: Draw the fence to see its side view.
profile.ground_hint: Double-click the ground line to add an elevation sample
profile.sample_tooltip: Ground sample — drag vertically ({snap_mm} {u} snap) or click to type z
profile.node_tooltip: Corner height — drag vertically ({snap_mm} {u} snap) or click to type z; both adjacent sections follow
profile.wall_band_tooltip: Wall top — click to type the heights at the section start and end
profile.top_dot_tooltip: Base-top point — drag to move (drag onto a neighbour to make a step), click to type
profile.top_hint_tooltip: Double-click to give this base a top line
profile.top_band_tooltip: Base top — click to type the start/end heights; double-click the top edge to insert a point
profile.top_interior_hint: Interior points and steps are edited by dragging the dots
hint.height: Height: click a run to set the fence height for a range.
impact.none: No project would change — safe to apply.
impact.failure.generation_failed: Under this change the strategy for this project cannot be generated at all.
impact.failure.generation_failed_refs: Under this change the strategy for this project cannot be generated at all — blocked by {refs}.
quote.title: Quotes
quote.label: Label
quote.snapshot_banner: Snapshot quote “{label}” — frozen document, not the live BOM
quote.unresolved_supply: This quote can't be saved — {n} part(s) have no supplier; check the BOM tab for details.
checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.draw: Draw a fence section — ✏️ then click on the map, Enter to finish
checklist.gate: Add a gate — 🚪 then click a spot on a section
checklist.compute: Press ⚙ to compute the strategy and see your quote
editor.empty_cta: Click ✏️ and then the map to draw your first section
warning.excessive_step: Step of {step_mm} {u} at {element} exceeds the buildable maximum ({max_mm} {u}) — needs an engineered solution
warning.excessive_gap: Stepped span {element} leaves a {gap_mm} {u} gap underneath (limit {max_mm} {u})
warning.max_height_exceeded: {element} reaches {height_mm} {u} plumb height at the downhill end — above the {max_mm} {u} limit
warning.gate_on_slope: Gate {element} sits on a slope of {slope_permille}‰ (limit {max_permille}‰) — level the ground for the gate to swing
warning.insufficient_post_length: Post {element} needs {required_mm} {u} but {sku} is only {available_mm} {u} long — choose a longer post
warning.tilted_stepped: Section {run_id} combines tilted posts ({mode}) with stepped panels — stepped panels normally pair with plumb posts; check the design
warning.gate_kit_width_mismatch: Gate kit {sku} fits a {kit_width_mm} {u} opening but {element} is {opening_width_mm} {u} — the wrong gate would be priced
warning.no_gate_kit: No catalog product fits the {opening_width_mm} {u} opening of {element} — this gate cannot be priced
warning.height_not_supported: Fence model {model_ref} is not made in {n} of the panel heights in section {run_id} (from {min_mm} {u} to {max_mm} {u}) — change the height or choose another model
hint.draw_cm: Draw: click to place dots — or aim and type a length: a bare number is {u} ({ex_mm} = 42 m), or add a unit (4m, 250cm). Enter places the next dot exactly; Enter or double-click finishes the run, Esc cancels.
profile.level_title: Make the base top level (one elevation across the section, with a point at every ground break)
profile.match_title: Move this section's ends to meet the adjacent sections' base tops at the shared corners
profile.add_step_title: Put a step in the middle of the base top; drag its diamonds to move or resize it
profile.base_soil_hint: This section sits on soil — set a wall or concrete base to give it a top profile.
profile.base_needs_top: Give this section a base height first.
profile.base_no_neighbour: No adjacent section with a base top to match.
profile.base_bad_height: Height must be a number, 0 or more.
profile.segment_title: This piece of the base top
profile.segment_note: The rule sticks: later edits keep this segment horizontal or vertical until you set it free.
profile.segment_hint: Base top — click to make this piece horizontal or vertical; double-click to add a point
profile.segment_locked_step: Held vertical (a step) — click to change
profile.match_all_title: Level this whole section at the adjacent section's top elevation, so the two read as one wall
profile.base_locked_level: That end is held horizontal — free the segment, or use the neighbour's elevation.
strategy.none: No strategy yet — press ⚙ Generate strategy to lay out posts, spans and gates.
strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.click_hint: click any post, span or gate to see why it is there
structure.title: Structure
structure.empty: Generate a strategy to see how it is laid out and what it consists of.
structure.setting_out_hint: measured from the start of the section
structure.unassigned: Ordered beyond the elements (rounding, whole packages):
profile.closing_bay: The closing bay — set out from the start, so any tape error lands here.
error.run_predates_fence_model: This run was computed before fence models existed, so its structure cannot be read — press ⚙ Generate strategy to compute it again.
structure.stale: The drawing has changed since this strategy was computed — press ⚙ Generate strategy to lay out the new one.
structure.catalog_changed: The catalog has changed since this run was generated — press ⚙ Generate strategy to lay it out again.
structure.from_stock: Met from stock (bought on no line, still picked in the yard):
profile.gate_dim: Gate opening — this one must be exact
warning.gate_past_run_end: Gate at station {station_mm} {u} asks for {asked_mm} {u} but only {available_mm} {u} of the section remains — move it or shorten it.
warning.no_eligible_item: Nothing is eligible to supply the {role}{slot} at {pegs} — the fence model names no product for it.
warning.no_feasible_item: No product can supply the {role}{slot} at {pegs}: none of {skus} fits the piece it needs.
warning.substitute_needs_approval: {sku} is a suggested substitute for the {role}{slot} at {pegs} and needs approval before it can be used
supply.title: Parts that cannot be supplied
supply.hint: These lines are missing from the priced BOM below — the fence is short of them until a product can supply them.
supply.quote_blocked: A quote cannot be saved while a part has no supplier.
supply.consumables_unsupplied: Some fixings or concrete cannot be supplied either — the installer sheet itemises them.
structure.unreadable: This run cannot be read ({code}). There IS structure — regenerate the strategy, or fix what that code names.
error.fence_model_unknown_sku: No strategy was generated: the catalog has no product called {skus}. Fix the SKU in the knowledge rule that selects it, then generate again.
error.fence_model_invalid: No strategy was generated: fence model {model_ref} cannot be used ({n} problem(s)). {errors}
error.fence_model_not_found: No strategy was generated: fence model {model_id} is not available — it does not exist, or no version of it is published. Choose another model for this project or section.
popover.no_models: No published fence model can be chosen yet.
panel.title: Panel
panel.hint: The model decides the panel, and the panel decides the materials, the sizes and the structure — so choose it here, before you generate a strategy.
panel.default_none: No model chosen — this project builds to the legacy panel.
panel.see_panel_tab: Change it on the Panel tab.
panel.no_published_version: This model has no published version, so it cannot be previewed.
panel.preview_failed: The panel could not be priced. Check the height and the bay width.
panel.computing: Working out what one panel is made of…
panel.not_a_quote: A preview, not a quote: nothing here is stored, and stock on hand is not counted.
panel.unsupplied_title: Parts of this panel that cannot be supplied
panel.unsupplied_hint: These parts are missing from the priced table below — this panel is short of them, and the total does not include them.
